list: the official 55 trophies, with an original guide for each

trophies.guide: Finish the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Nothing on the list needs multiplayer or DLC, and the whole set is single-player. Budget around 200 hours: the story takes 60 to 80, and the 100% checklist takes most of the rest.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.tip: Keep manual saves at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay.

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is the first mission of the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.tip: Unlocks automatically as the story opens.

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. The trophy pops when the first chapter closes and Chapter 2 begins.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.tip: Story only — just keep playing.

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. The trophy pops as Chapter 3 opens.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.tip: Story only — just keep playing.

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. The trophy pops as Chapter 4 opens.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.tip: Story only — just keep playing.

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission is done.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.tip: Story only — just keep playing.

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. It is the last story beat, so it pops with the credits.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.tip: Save before the final mission — there is no mission replay.

trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks automatically as part of the story.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.tip: Story only — just keep playing.

trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks automatically as part of the story.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.tip: Story only — just keep playing.

trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. It unlocks automatically as part of the story.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.tip: Story only — just keep playing.

trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. It unlocks automatically as part of the story.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.tip: Story only — just keep playing.

trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks automatically as part of the story.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.tip: Story only — just keep playing.

trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks automatically as part of the story.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.tip: Story only — just keep playing.

trophies.guide: After the story, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and work the checklist. It is far more forgiving than it sounds — roughly 60% true completion — and progress made during the story already counts. Only robberies, underwater finds, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's hunts demand everything; most other lines need only 70 to 80%, and any 70 of the 80 challenges will do.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.tip: Do optional missions as they appear — you need any 100 of them.

trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix categories however you like; flying under bridges is the fastest. The 100% checklist wants 300, so this pops on the way.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.tip: Track by region in Progress, Activities, Stunts.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, video games, racing, and stunts. Check your count in Touchpad, Progress, Activities. Most come up naturally in the story and while clearing the map.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.tip: Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find the ones you missed.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges spread over 12 ranges. Gold is lenient — steady aim and the range's own rhythm matter more than speed. All 42 are also needed for the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.tip: The ranges are marked once you unfog the map.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations (42 races in total). Any win at a location counts, so pick the shortest course at each spot. All of them are needed for the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.tip: Drone races are an activity type — they also feed Master of None.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations around Leonida. Any race type counts — cars, bikes and the rest — as long as each win is at a different location.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.tip: Race locations show on the map once the area is unfogged.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui introduces Cal, he texts you a fishing spot (purple icon). Follow his short questline and beat him in a fishing challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.tip: Fishing also raises Focus, which helps Gunslinger.

trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home, or Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the map. You only need to reach the end of one game once — no need to clear every challenge.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.tip: The home games are playable from Chapter 1.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Follow Andy's optional questline in Chapter 3 (Lucia only). A call from Andy, then her texts mark the line in Belville. Five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.tip: Questline is Lucia-only — switch to her.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Follow Kenton's treasure-diving line from Chapter 1 (green KR icon in Key Lento). He marks shipwrecks on the map; dive down, dig the treasure out with the metal detector and bring it back. Seven shipwrecks in total. He goes quiet for a stretch in Chapters 2 to 3 and comes back, so nothing is missable.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.tip: Track it in Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Follow Billy's line after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break (Thrillbilly Mudclub, Kelly County). Five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All still available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.tip: The Impaler asks you to steal a specific car — grab it when the quest marks it.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger strands — but only some questlines count. Confirmed counters are Kirk (Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries). Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this one. Everything stays available in free-roam.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.tip: Watch the trophy tracker in the trophy list to see your count.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner. Randy wants 16 sports cars; scan cars with the WAiNK app to check the list, steal them and deliver them to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Delivering them undamaged pays more.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.tip: Track the list in Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Follow Tyrone's line (Jason only) after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers point at Synthetic Labs — destroy them in Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone hands you Spin On This. Still available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.tip: Jason-only — switch characters if it is not showing.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; meditating with both characters at one spot counts twice. Track them in Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. This is the one trophy that can be missed: the first meditation happens at Jason's house in Chapter 1, when Lucia walks out to the balcony in the morning after Down to Earth — talk to her in the kitchen, follow her out and choose Accept. After Chapter 1 that moment is gone, so keep a manual save from Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.tip: Do it the first morning it is offered — do not leave it for later.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Follow Bret Vogel's hunting line (Jason only), which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break when Bret texts you — first quest Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. He marks hunting spots; hunt the animals he asks for and bring them to him. His first quest gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle (collect it from any Ammu-Nation locker). All 15 Target Decks are needed for 100% anyway.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.tip: One clean shot leaves the animal pristine and pays more.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida in 18 set locations; you do not need every card, just three finished sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.tip: Grab cards whenever you pass a set location.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK points with the phone app (hold Up, then R1 on a target): 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and more. There are well over 100 in the world, so any 100 will do.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.tip: Scan everything you walk past — it also feeds Whip It Good.

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70, so this pops on the way — pick the easiest ones and skip the hardest 10. Track them in Progress, Challenges.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.tip: Leave this for late; dozens complete themselves while you chase other trophies.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Once you can free-roam as a pair (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break), call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle), build a 4-star wanted level together, then escape the red heat zone — not just the flashing search area. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the easy escape: cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 bank-vault mission.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.tip: Use a fast motorcycle and cut through traffic.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops back-to-back while holding a wanted level (keep the flashing red/blue level, not full heat). Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after the third shop. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well once Yasmani's jobs have unlocked them.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.tip: If it does not pop after three, hit a fourth — the count keeps going.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1 on a vehicle). Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing — you only need to scan, not drive. There are 557 vehicles at launch; the 100% checklist wants 200 base models scanned.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.tip: Check your totals in Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming — time slows and weak spots light up). Buff Focus first with food, drinks or a wash, and pop Adrenaline to stretch the window. Gang operations give you grouped enemies; an assault rifle like the Duke 556 helps. It does not count on soldiers, police or civilians.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.tip: Raise Focus to level 4 first (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots).

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a big passenger jet docked at a departure terminal at VCIA — it must be one connected to a boarding bridge, not the planes on the field. Easiest is terminals E3/E4: slip through a fence, climb the stairs by the bridge straight into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the strip and take off. Fly about 1 km from the airport and it pops.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.tip: Going over the airfield fence is faster than walking through the terminal.

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.tip: The tanks sit in the south of the base — look for the armor park.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs unlocks the Snap Gun, break into a jewelry store through the back door with it — no alarm, no detection. Find the note with the safe code inside, open the safe and loot it. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a reliable spot.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.tip: Kicking the door sets the alarm off — always use the Snap Gun prompt.

trophies.guide: After the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe), tail a security van to a bank and slip in while the vault is open — bring your partner, you cannot carry all the cash alone. After that, buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 a tip (finish his earlier jobs first, including two Payday Loans). Any 5 of the 8 large bank jobs count; all 8 are needed for 100%. Each vault pays up to $205,000 — and instantly gives a 4-star wanted level.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.tip: Escape on a fast motorcycle, then swap cars to lose the heat.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The Chapter 4 mission above counts automatically, since a bank vault job starts with a truck. Or do it earlier: block a truck near a bank, stick a bomb on its back door, blow it open and get clear of the heat radius. Sticky bombs come from the back of Yasmani's shop.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.tip: The trophy only pops once you are out of the red heat zone.

trophies.guide: Unfog the entire map — all 52 areas of Leonida. Fly a plane over every black-fogged patch until the map is fully visible.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.tip: A plane is far faster than driving every road.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked by story progress. All 39 are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way. Track each gang in Progress, Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.tip: Robbing a gang's operation also feeds your Criminal Profile.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No verified method has been published yet at launch — guide sites list this one as unknown — so do not chase rumors. Check back once players pin it down.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.tip: Unconfirmed at launch — listed here so you know it is not just you.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight out through the window. You need the Key Cloner first (Chapter 3, Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs). Only that blue Banshee counts — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. The pop is slightly delayed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.tip: Drive forward through the glass; it pops once you are clear on the street.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation, first visited in the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling), steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it with sticky bombs). The trophy pops after you escape the police. You do not need all three in one visit — the robbery icon respawns.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.tip: Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation before you go.

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch freely). Work out together — call your partner along, and while one trains the other progresses too. Gym memberships help; filter fitness clubs on the map. Check Strength in Touchpad, Jason & Lucia.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.tip: Train with both characters present — it doubles the progress.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Turn the counter on in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile — a small demon face flashes whenever an action counts, and clicking the trophy shows your total. Stealthy jobs push you Professional, sparing enemies Hardened, killing Violent, mass killing Psycho — and Irredeemable is permanent, so avoid going that far. Most of the 500 happen naturally across robberies and fights.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.tip: If you are short at the end, running over pedestrians and cops tops it up fast.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — but the exact trigger is not verified at launch. The working belief is that it ties to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Treat any specific method you see online as unconfirmed until a guide reproduces it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.tip: Unconfirmed at launch — do not waste hours on guesses.

trophies.guide: Find the UFO easter egg: the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM, alone. Sometimes a car with flickering lights waits at the roadside — if it is there, follow the path into the woods toward the bright blue light. The UFO drops an abducted woman; talk to her, offer to help, then go back to her car. The spawn is random, so drive away and come back if the car is not there.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.tip: Go solo and after 2 AM — the car only shows at night.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — but the exact trigger is not verified at launch. The working belief is kicking enemies from a motorcycle. Until a guide reproduces it, treat methods you see online as unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.tip: Unconfirmed at launch — listed as unknown, not as a how-to.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer, rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays best. $250,000 in total, counted across all robberies, not in one trip. Bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in a few minutes.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.tip: Vault jobs from Chapter 4 onward make this quick.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way there — the most expensive items in the game.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.tip: It counts across every shop type, so normal play covers much of it.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total) through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone — it installs after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. The 4 story garages do not count. Robberies in Chapters 3 to 4 pay for them fast.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.tip: Garages also unlock parking for On the Spot.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app (installed after the Chapter 2 mission with Moses). You need garage space first — each garage adds spots — then drive stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and Register. Early on he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, standard-tracker cars can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Cheap cars and bikes keep the fees low.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.tip: Registering costs money — use low-end cars.
